counter_analysis: Mechanism premise (Asian retail front-running global institutional flow) is unverified ex ante and would require its OWN independent substantiation BEFORE bolting onto a 2x-falsified OI velocity substrate.

If Asian retail leads global institutional, the alpha mechanism would manifest in PRICE lead-lag (Bybit price t leads Binance price t+Δ), NOT in OI lead-lag. OI is a stock derivative variable lagging price action; OI velocity correlation lead-lag is double-derivative and would lose any embedded signal.

The candidate-pool perm_p trap that destroyed paradigm 104 at primary 4h hold operates on forward returns regardless of which exchange's OI triggered selection. Selection mechanism (Bybit OI vs Binance OI vs cross-exchange differential vs lead-lag) narrows the trigger subset; the forward-return pool drift is unchanged. perm_p will remain >> 0.10 at 4h hold.
